Workflows.title: Launch the bank simulator and enter the dashboard
Workflows.goal: The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog appears with the heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator'; The welcome dialog closes and the dashboard is fully visible showing checking account balance of $216.04, savings account balance of $230.00, and upcoming bills
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Click the GET STARTED NOW button on the landing page — The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog appears with the heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator'
2. Click Ok on the welcome dialog to dismiss it — The welcome dialog closes and the dashboard is fully visible showing checking account balance of $216.04, savings account balance of $230.00, and upcoming bills

Workflows.title: View checking and savings account transaction history
Workflows.goal: The Account Activity page loads at /bank-sim/account with a transaction table showing columns Id, Date, Description, Amount, Balance, and Actions, with the Checking tab active by default; The Checking tab shows at least the 'Account Opening' row with $250.00 amount and a running balance, plus subsequent debit transactions; The Saving tab becomes active and the transaction table updates to show savings account rows including a Network ATM withdrawal and the account-opening entry; the pagination reads '1 – 2 of 2'
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to the landing page, click GET STARTED NOW, dismiss the welcome dialog, then open the ACCOUNTS nav menu and click ACCOUNT ACTIVITY — The Account Activity page loads at /bank-sim/account with a transaction table showing columns Id, Date, Description, Amount, Balance, and Actions, with the Checking tab active by default
2. Verify the Checking tab is active and transaction rows are displayed including the account-opening entry — The Checking tab shows at least the 'Account Opening' row with $250.00 amount and a running balance, plus subsequent debit transactions
3. Click the Saving tab to switch to the savings account view — The Saving tab becomes active and the transaction table updates to show savings account rows including a Network ATM withdrawal and the account-opening entry; the pagination reads '1 – 2 of 2'

test_steps.action: Navigate to the landing page, click GET STARTED NOW, dismiss the welcome dialog, then open the ACCOUNTS nav menu and click ACCOUNT ACTIVITY
test_steps.expected: The Account Activity page loads at /bank-sim/account with a transaction table showing columns Id, Date, Description, Amount, Balance, and Actions, with the Checking tab active by default

test_steps.expected: The Saving tab becomes active and the transaction table updates to show savings account rows including a Network ATM withdrawal and the account-opening entry; the pagination reads '1 – 2 of 2'

Workflows.title: Search transactions on the Account Activity page
Workflows.goal: The Account Activity page is displayed with the Checking transaction table showing multiple rows; The transaction table filters live to show only rows whose description contains 'Streamwave'; non-matching rows are hidden; The full unfiltered transaction list is restored in the table
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to ACCOUNTS > ACCOUNT ACTIVITY via the nav menu — The Account Activity page is displayed with the Checking transaction table showing multiple rows
2. Type a transaction description keyword (for example 'Streamwave') into the Search textbox — The transaction table filters live to show only rows whose description contains 'Streamwave'; non-matching rows are hidden
3. Clear the search textbox content — The full unfiltered transaction list is restored in the table

Workflows.title: Open the Make a Transfer form and verify Save button is disabled with empty required fields
Workflows.goal: The Transfer Money form page loads at /bank-sim/transfer with required fields PAYMENT FREQUENCY, Transfer From, Transfer To, Amount, and Payment Date visible; All three comboboxes are empty and no transfer account is selected; The Save button is disabled, preventing submission when required fields are unfilled; No transfer is created; the user remains on or is navigated away from the transfer form without any mutation to account data
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the TRANSFERS nav menu and click MAKE A TRANSFER — The Transfer Money form page loads at /bank-sim/transfer with required fields PAYMENT FREQUENCY, Transfer From, Transfer To, Amount, and Payment Date visible
2. Observe the PAYMENT FREQUENCY, Transfer From, and Transfer To comboboxes without selecting any value — All three comboboxes are empty and no transfer account is selected
3. Observe the Save button state — The Save button is disabled, preventing submission when required fields are unfilled
4. Click the Cancel button — No transfer is created; the user remains on or is navigated away from the transfer form without any mutation to account data
